basis: three coupled rotational axes with attitude-error/rate phase-plane switching and pulsed RCS actuation
discrete two-jet/four-jet and pitch/roll selection modes plus thrust-authority/propellant-use tradeoff
five private conditions vary command, initial rate, jet mode, and available thrust authority
distinct from XAERO-08 rocket trajectory/terminal flight and XAERO-11 orbit-coupled spacecraft ADCS

A.meaning: three-axis attitude, rate, and tracking-error trajectory accuracy

Q.meaning: finite complete logs with exact public interface and time coverage

M.meaning: phase-plane/RCS switching and thrust-authority mechanism fidelity

C.meaning: command, initial-rate, jet-mode, and force-scale causal fidelity

R.meaning: worst private-condition accuracy and numerical robustness

D.meaning: rate recovery, tracking transient, and jet switching dynamics

score_policy.across_groups: weighted geometric mean; missing critical mechanism or causal behavior may zero its group

minimum_shortcut_sanity_contract: one scenario replayed for every intervention
